purpose: Write ordinary meaningful open source words through one familiar spelling lesson, then conceal adjacent letter order with one pending sign. The same hand operation reverses the concealment. No word is assigned a new meaning and no independent concept gets a private whole-word number.

carrier_dependency.reuse: The entire old carrier and all16 compulsory case-sensitive shortcuts are unchanged. That proposal remains historically unreviewed in the registry, but related1179A and1202/1226 failures are explicitly retained; raw status is not evidence of an unexecuted family.

teaching_carrier.ordinary_lowercase: Source a–s map in alphabetic order to the first19 signs in ordinary_signs; t–z map to q followed by the first7 ordinary signs. This is one general letter table, never a word table.
teaching_carrier.rare_character_rule: For zero-based index j in rare_characters_in_order, write y followed by rare_selectors[floor(j/8)] and rare_selectors[j mod 8]. All three marks are consumed as one source character. Unlisted source characters are outside this teaching edition and cause an explicit failure, never deletion or guessed replacement.
teaching_carrier.marker: r never occurs in the letter carrier and is reserved for the mechanism declared in this card.
teaching_carrier.source_contract: Inputs are nonempty source tokens separated by single spaces, with explicit paragraph breaks. Uppercase, listed punctuation and digits are retained by the rare-character table. Repeated whitespace and exact physical source lineation are outside the declared input contract; semantic words, word order and paragraph boundaries are retained. No lowercasing, grammatical normalization or expansion of ambiguous historical spelling is performed.
teaching_carrier.reader_cost: The learner must know the source language, its ordinary spellings, the26 lowercase entries and the entire listed rare-character table, plus the mechanism-specific table/rules. Rare-character escape can be slow and long; its cost is charged. Drawings are already familiar transcription-designated shapes, but their artificial assignment is not a native letter or word-value claim.
teaching_carrier.decoding: Parse ordinary single signs, q plus exactly one permitted letter selector, or y plus exactly two rare selectors; reject unused combinations. The distinct marker r cannot be confused with a spelled source character. Multi-letter transcription labels such as ch name one working drawing here, without claiming that native writing has independently established these atoms.

carrier_dependency.fixed_scan: Within each nonempty source token, greedily take the longest listed shortcut and write r+its selector; otherwise use the copied literal character rule. No shortcut crosses a source space. Reverse by that table and reject any decoded group that does not reproduce exactly under this same canonical scan.

input_domain.text: One or more nonempty paragraphs, each a nonempty sequence of nonempty tokens separated by single source spaces. All26 lowercase and the56 copied rare characters are admitted, including case, punctuation and digits. Repeated whitespace and original physical lineation are not input distinctions.
input_domain.open_names: Any new name over those82 characters uses the same literal/substring rule and needs no new name entry. An unlisted character is an explicit domain failure, never silently normalized, deleted or guessed.
input_domain.semantic_inverse: Recover the exact declared tokens, punctuation, case, order and paragraph breaks. The reader uses their learned source language. Ambiguity already present in those words stays ambiguous; no quantities, pronoun referents or participants are supplied by the notation.

core_writer: Encode every source token with the unchanged935 carrier. Keep each ordinary interword gap after its original number of working drawings, not after its number of source characters.

Within each paragraph, count working drawings continuously while ignoring gaps. Swap drawings1/2,3/4,5/6 and so on. If a gap lies between the two positions of a pair, exchange the drawings across that gap but keep the gap at the same position.

If the paragraph has an odd number of drawings, leave its last drawing unchanged. Start the next explicitly marked paragraph with a fresh first pair. No physical-line reset, word reset, counter-selected alphabet or discretionary alias is allowed.
Apply the physical line layer below only after this permutation. Its control drawings do not enter the pair count.
core_reader: Undo the physical line layer first, restoring the complete logical groups and explicit paragraph breaks.

Within each paragraph apply the identical adjacent-pair permutation ignoring gaps but keeping their positions. This is an involution and exactly restores every935 group, even when an output group by itself is not a legal935 string.
Decode each restored group through the unchanged935 table and verify its canonical scan. Read the recovered ordinary source text. Do not attempt to parse the permuted display group directly as935.

paid_line_layer.width: Fixed teaching width24 cells. Each working drawing and each ordinary interior gap costs one cell. This small line counter is an explicit operational/layout cost, not an established native ruling or a tuned native parameter. Multi-letter labels such as cph still occupy one drawing cell.
paid_line_layer.row_end_rule: Let k be the number of literal r drawings at the end of the logical content placed on the row. If the row ends at a logical group boundary, replace that terminal r-run by2k copies of r. If the row splits a group, replace it by2k+1 copies of r. All other drawings and interior word gaps are copied unchanged.
paid_line_layer.greedy_layout: From the remaining logical paragraph choose the longest nonempty prefix ending just after a drawing for which the resulting row, including the escaped terminal run and any continuation r, fits24cells. A cut at a group boundary consumes the following logical word space, which the physical newline will carry. A cut inside a group consumes no logical word space. A cut at paragraph end has the boundary form with an even terminal r-run. No empty row is inserted inside a paragraph.
paid_line_layer.paragraph_marker: An empty physical row ends the paragraph; the final end of the document also ends it. An ordinary nonempty-row break never resets pair parity. An odd terminal run at a paragraph end is malformed.
paid_line_layer.row_reader: Count the trailing run of r on each physical row. Restore floor(run/2) literal r drawings. An odd run means concatenate the next nonempty row without a space; an even run means insert one logical word gap before the next row in the same paragraph. At an explicit paragraph end insert no trailing word gap. This run parity cannot be mistaken for a carrier r because all literal terminal r drawings were doubled.
paid_line_layer.overwide_tokens: Long words may span several rows using the odd-run continuation. Even an arbitrarily long literal r-run can be written: a row carrying k such literal drawings and continuation costs2k+1cells, so the width24 rule always admits a nonempty next piece. No word is truncated or substituted to fit.
paid_line_layer.cost_and_limit: Physical continuation creates additional visible marks and sometimes additional physical groups. A future statistical comparison must not silently count reconstructed logical groups as if they were observed physical groups. This fixed layer is not permission to vary line breaks to improve a score.

complete_hand_example.status: Open invented teaching paragraph, selected to explain the operation; not externally sampled, blinded or historical source evidence.
complete_hand_example.meaning: Ada has salt. Wait. No addressee, amount or duration is inferred beyond this ordinary text.
complete_hand_example.physical_readback: The first row ends with one r, so remove that continuation control and join its final s directly to the next row. This restores the fourth logical group sascphaaqynso. No pair state is reset at the row break. Swap continuous pairs again while preserving all three logical spaces; the four listed base groups return. The old literal table returns Ada / hat / Salz. / Warte., including uppercase and both periods.
complete_hand_example.why_frequency_is_not_word_local: The first output group ends in l borrowed from the next base word, while the second output group ends in y borrowed from the following word. The same source word can therefore have different complete displayed forms depending on its neighbour drawings and pair phase. A proof for a single word-local spelling does not apply automatically.
complete_hand_example.provenance: All arrays and the short readback were worked out by hand. The file-writing command did not implement an encoder or decoder.

costs.learning: The already declared26 lowercase correspondences,56 rare-character correspondences and16 exact shortcuts; knowledge of the ordinary source language; adjacent-pair exchange; terminal-r parity convention and the24-cell physical line rule. This is finite, but not a cost-free tiny alphabet.
costs.memory: One pending working drawing and whether a word gap lies inside its pair; pair continuity across physical lines; at most24 layout cells while writing. Reader may make a two-pass scratch copy to unfold rows and reverse pairs. No remembered previous words, dynamic dictionary, semantic oracle or hidden plaintext neighbour is used.
costs.length: Before physical wrapping the group lengths and the entire glyph multiset are exactly those of935. costs.untested_statistics: No q/o explanation, y-ending frequency, interior entropy, type profile or native adequacy is claimed. The line layer adds cost rather than compression.

retained_known_pretest_counterexample.phase0: If the first q of the middle six-drawing group occupies an odd global pair position, inverse exchange gives [o,q,e,k,y,d]. The terminal y,d has only one of the two compulsory rare selectors, so it is an invalid complete935word.
retained_known_pretest_counterexample.phase1: If that q occupies an even global pair position, the previous repeated group supplies its final y and the next supplies its initial q. The inverse middle group is[y,k,o,d,e,q]. Its y is immediately followed by k, which is not one of the eight permitted rare selectors; the final q also lacks its compulsory selector. It is invalid.
retained_known_pretest_counterexample.conclusion: Both possible global pair phases contradict the unchanged literal935carrier before any unknown source words, source counts, optimal key or large implementation. A physical line start cannot supply a third phase. No exceptions, selector repairs or new aliases are added.
retained_known_pretest_counterexample.strict_ceiling: This closes only the literal working-label realization. No exhaustive proof over all global22-drawing renamings is supplied, and the abstract pair-transposition mechanism is not generally refuted. The original857 cyclic-pool theorem remains a separate result; reusing its stored witness is not rediscovering the triple.

additional_conditional_constraint: Under this fixed935carrier every complete base word ends in an ordinary selector. No complete word has y as its penultimate drawing because rare y units have two following selectors. Consequently an unwrapped paragraph-final word cannot end in y after adjacent-pair swapping either; physical final-row escaping can add only r. A native application would need a separately bound existing paragraph-final witness before calling this another native exclusion; none was queried here.
